title: Method of Endogenous TSH Stimulation in the Follow-up of Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
brief_summary: The treatment of differentiated thyroid cancer (DCT) includes surgery followed by radioiodine treatment. In the follow-up of patients it is necessary to induce TSH elevation to test for cancer recurrence. One of the options is to stop L-thyroxin replacement for several weeks. Current pilot study aims to induce the necessary TSH elevation by decreasing the L-thyroxin dose. The main hypothesis is that necessary TSH stimulation will be achieved during 4-6 weeks in majority of patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Differentiated thyroid cancer
* treated by thyroidectomy and at least 1 ablation with 131-I \> 5 months ago
* TSH \< 4 imU/L

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Known metastasis
